title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E20: Optional Provider Verifiable Receipt Attestation Study
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4
conditionality_rule: Executed ONLY if live provider hardware/verifiable receipt capabilities are active in environment. Otherwise set status to NOT_RUN_PROVIDER_ATTESTATION_UNAVAILABLE.

primary_endpoints.name: Provider Receipt Attestation Parity
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of valid hardware/verifiable receipts successfully verified by kernel without signature or nonce mismatch.

secondary_endpoints.name: Receipt Verification Latency Overhead
secondary_endpoints.definition: Additional latency in milliseconds introduced by provider cryptographic receipt verification.

sample_size.unit_definition: 100 provider-attested inference receipt payloads evaluated under live or conditional ledger

statistical_plan.method: Conditional Provider Receipt Evaluation and Verification Latency Profiling

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: If hardware/verifiable provider receipts are unavailable, mark experiment status as NOT_RUN_PROVIDER_ATTESTATION_UNAVAILABLE without blocking publication release (Gate 4). Mock or synthetic signatures are strictly forbidden.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Receipt validation timeouts or unhandled provider exceptions fail closed.
